// diagnostic

E0622

A `#Persist` binding's value must be a literal

What

A `#Persist` binding's value must be a literal

Why

A `#Persist` module global is hot-reload state, which every execution tier initializes from a scalar literal before `run: fn`. A plain mutable global or an immutable `:` constant may compute its value, which the build works out and stores in the program.

Fix

Use an integer, float, or bool literal, or drop `#Persist` so the build computes the global's starting value.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0622: tests/ui/module_array_computed_element.stderr.

Error [jet.ModuleGlobalNotLiteral]: A `#Persist` binding's value must be a literal
  --> tests/ui/module_array_computed_element.jet:1:23
    |
  1 | #Persist bad_table := [Int]{1 + 2}
    |                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^
